title: Wind of Tishanian
wikitext:
{{Spellpage|

| spellname = Wind of Tishanian
| spellicon = T
| description = Causes the ears of all creatures in a small radius around your target to echo with the barking of Tashan, lowering their magic resistance. <s>Use this spell when you want your character to die fast.</s> Previously caused a high amount of threat.

Usage tips: this spell is often considered garbage but is a good time saver when reverse charming. Root everything down and plop one into the pack. Also good in chardok to drop in a pack and then gating before lulling. Takes a little extra time but makes lulling a lot more reliable on top of having your named pre-tashed.
